notes: All 25 candidates reviewed from the saved text files; all not-a-list, none program-list or single-record. Institutions by host kept as given (TU Darmstadt, TU Dortmund, DTU); no page belonged to another institution. Items an integrator may still want: (1) http://people.compute.dtu.dk/jbjo/theses.html names 20 completed PhD theses (1997-2019) supervised by one DTU Compute professor in model predictive control and numerical optimization; marked not-a-list following earlier reviews of personal supervisor pages in non-operations departments, but it is a clean name/title/year list if DTU Compute optimization is ever brought into scope. (2) hdhf.zhb.tu-dortmund.de doctoral-graduates names two 2021 doctoral graduates of the Professorship of Higher Education with dissertation titles; organization/governance topics but a higher-education research center, not a business school. (3) flw.mb.tu-dortmund.de news item records Moritz Roidl's intralogistics dissertation defense (13 July 2022, Chair of Materials Handling and Warehousing, examiner Michael ten Hompel); marked not-a-list because the brief classes news items so, although it is a single-person degree-completion fact in a logistics chair. The seven ifs.ep.tu-dortmund.de pages are three psychology dissertation news items each captured under two or three addresses (German/English, details/newsdetail); all outside scope. The two large TU Dortmund pages (ed.wiwi, im.mb) and all Darmstadt pages are thesis-topic adverts or master's-thesis lists with no doctoral graduates.
